_comment: Curated TripWise catalog. Attraction coordinates, durations and costs are editorial approximations (verify before publishing). dailyCostUsd = typical mid-range spend per person per day. Photos: Unsplash License; relevance reviewed via the catalog-images CI contact sheet.

destinations.name: Bali
destinations.summary: Volcanic highlands, terraced rice fields and surf beaches, with a living Hindu culture woven through daily life.

attractions.name: Mount Batur sunrise trek
attractions.description: Pre-dawn hike up an active volcano for sunrise above the clouds.

attractions.name: Tegallalang Rice Terraces
attractions.description: Sculpted green terraces irrigated by the centuries-old subak system.

attractions.name: Uluwatu Temple
attractions.description: Clifftop sea temple with a Kecak fire dance at sunset.

attractions.name: Sacred Monkey Forest, Ubud
attractions.description: Jungle sanctuary with temples and long-tailed macaques.

attractions.name: Ubud Art Market
attractions.description: Handicrafts, batik and woodcarvings in central Ubud.

destinations.name: Kyoto
destinations.summary: Japan's former capital: more than a thousand temples, wooden machiya streets and an exceptional food culture.

attractions.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
attractions.description: Thousands of vermilion torii gates winding up Mount Inari.

attractions.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
attractions.description: Towering bamboo paths, best before the morning crowds.

attractions.name: Kiyomizu-dera
attractions.description: Wooden hillside temple with a famous stage over the valley.

attractions.name: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
attractions.description: Gold-leaf pavilion reflected in a mirror pond.

attractions.name: Nishiki Market
attractions.description: Covered market known as Kyoto's kitchen.

attractions.name: Gion evening walk
attractions.description: Lantern-lit streets of the historic geisha district.

destinations.name: Tokyo
destinations.summary: A vast, orderly megacity where neon districts sit beside quiet shrines and some of the world's best restaurants.

attractions.name: Senso-ji, Asakusa
attractions.description: Tokyo's oldest temple and the Nakamise shopping street.

attractions.name: Shibuya Crossing
attractions.description: The world's busiest pedestrian scramble.

attractions.name: Meiji Jingu
attractions.description: Forest shrine dedicated to Emperor Meiji.

attractions.name: teamLab Planets
attractions.description: Immersive digital art you walk through barefoot.

attractions.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
attractions.description: Sushi, tamagoyaki and street snacks from early morning.

attractions.name: Tokyo Skytree
attractions.description: 634 m tower with city-wide views.

destinations.name: Seoul
destinations.summary: Palaces and hanok villages framed by mountains, with round-the-clock markets and a fast-moving pop culture.

attractions.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
attractions.description: Grand Joseon palace with the changing of the guard.

attractions.name: Bukchon Hanok Village
attractions.description: Hillside lanes of traditional wooden houses.

attractions.name: Myeongdong
attractions.description: Street food stalls and K-beauty shopping.

attractions.name: N Seoul Tower
attractions.description: Views over the city from Namsan mountain.

attractions.name: Gwangjang Market
attractions.description: Bindaetteok and mayak gimbap at a century-old market.

destinations.name: Bangkok
destinations.summary: Gilded temples, floating markets and a legendary street-food scene along the Chao Phraya river.

attractions.name: Grand Palace
attractions.description: Former royal residence and the Temple of the Emerald Buddha.

attractions.name: Wat Arun
attractions.description: Porcelain-covered riverside temple, glowing at sunset.

attractions.name: Wat Pho
attractions.description: Home of the 46 m reclining Buddha and Thai massage school.

attractions.name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
attractions.description: More than 15,000 stalls of food, crafts and clothes.

attractions.name: Damnoen Saduak Floating Market
attractions.description: Boat vendors selling fruit and noodles on the canals.

destinations.name: Singapore
destinations.summary: A green, spotless city-state where hawker centres, futuristic gardens and four cultures meet.

attractions.name: Gardens by the Bay
attractions.description: Supertree Grove and the cooled Flower Dome conservatory.

attractions.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
attractions.description: Observation deck 57 floors above the bay.

attractions.name: Maxwell Food Centre
attractions.description: Hawker classics including Hainanese chicken rice.

attractions.name: Sentosa Island
attractions.description: Beaches, cable car and attractions off the south coast.

attractions.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed gardens with the National Orchid Garden.

destinations.name: Dubai
destinations.summary: Record-breaking skyscrapers, desert dunes and old souks along the creek.

attractions.name: Burj Khalifa At the Top
attractions.description: Observation decks in the world's tallest building.

attractions.name: Desert safari
attractions.description: Dune drive, camel ride and dinner under the stars.

attractions.name: Al Fahidi Historic District
attractions.description: Wind-tower houses and museums of old Dubai.

attractions.name: Gold and Spice Souks
attractions.description: Traditional markets across the creek by abra boat.

attractions.name: The Dubai Mall
attractions.description: Aquarium, fountain shows and hundreds of shops.

destinations.name: Agra
destinations.summary: Home of the Taj Mahal and a cluster of Mughal masterpieces on the banks of the Yamuna.

attractions.name: Taj Mahal
attractions.description: Marble mausoleum, best at sunrise from the main gate.

attractions.name: Agra Fort
attractions.description: Red sandstone Mughal fort with views of the Taj.

attractions.name: Mehtab Bagh
attractions.description: Riverside garden facing the Taj Mahal.

attractions.name: Itimad-ud-Daulah
attractions.description: Inlaid marble tomb nicknamed the 'Baby Taj'.

attractions.name: Fatehpur Sikri
attractions.description: Abandoned Mughal capital 40 km from Agra.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.summary: The Pink City: hilltop forts, palace courtyards and bazaars full of block prints and gems.

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.description: Hilltop fort-palace with mirrored halls.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal
attractions.description: Honeycomb 'Palace of Winds' facade.

attractions.name: City Palace
attractions.description: Royal residence, museums and courtyards.

attractions.name: Jantar Mantar
attractions.description: 18th-century astronomical instruments in stone.

attractions.name: Johari Bazaar
attractions.description: Gems, textiles and block-printed fabrics.

destinations.name: Kerala Backwaters
destinations.summary: A slow network of palm-lined lagoons and canals, best seen from a traditional houseboat.

attractions.name: Alleppey houseboat cruise
attractions.description: Overnight on a kettuvallam through palm-lined canals.

attractions.name: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
attractions.description: Migratory birds on the banks of Vembanad Lake.

attractions.name: Fort Kochi
attractions.description: Chinese fishing nets, colonial streets and street art.

attractions.name: Kathakali performance
attractions.description: Classical dance-drama with elaborate make-up.

attractions.name: Marari Beach
attractions.description: Quiet fishing-village beach near Alleppey.

destinations.name: Ha Long Bay
destinations.summary: Thousands of limestone islands rising from emerald water, explored by junk boat and kayak.

attractions.name: Overnight junk cruise
attractions.description: Sail among limestone karsts with meals on board.

attractions.name: Sung Sot Cave
attractions.description: One of the bay's largest and most spectacular caves.

attractions.name: Kayaking the lagoons
attractions.description: Paddle through hidden lagoons and karst arches.

attractions.name: Ti Top Island viewpoint
attractions.description: Climb for a panorama over the bay.

attractions.name: Bai Tho Mountain
attractions.description: Viewpoint above Ha Long city.

destinations.name: Maldives
destinations.summary: Coral atolls with overwater villas, clear lagoons and some of the world's best snorkelling.

attractions.name: House reef snorkelling
attractions.description: Coral, reef sharks and turtles steps from the shore.

attractions.name: Banana Reef dive
attractions.description: One of the Maldives' first and most famous dive sites.

attractions.name: Sandbank picnic
attractions.description: A private strip of sand in the middle of the lagoon.

attractions.name: Malé Fish Market
attractions.description: Morning tuna catch in the capital.

attractions.name: Old Friday Mosque, Malé
attractions.description: 17th-century mosque built from coral stone.

destinations.name: Santorini
destinations.summary: White villages on volcanic cliffs above a flooded caldera, famous for its sunsets and wines.

attractions.name: Oia sunset
attractions.description: The island's famous sunset over the caldera.

attractions.name: Caldera boat tour
attractions.description: Volcano hike, hot springs and swimming stops.

attractions.name: Red Beach
attractions.description: Beach framed by red volcanic cliffs.

attractions.name: Akrotiri archaeological site
attractions.description: Bronze Age town preserved under volcanic ash.

attractions.name: Fira to Oia hike
attractions.description: 10 km caldera-rim trail between villages.

attractions.name: Santo Wines
attractions.description: Assyrtiko tasting on a terrace above the caldera.

destinations.name: Paris
destinations.summary: Grand boulevards, world-class museums and café terraces along the Seine.

attractions.name: The Louvre
attractions.description: The world's most visited museum, home of the Mona Lisa.

attractions.name: Eiffel Tower
attractions.description: Iconic iron tower; summit views at dusk.

attractions.name: Montmartre and Sacré-Cœur
attractions.description: Artists' hill with a basilica overlooking the city.

attractions.name: Musée d'Orsay
attractions.description: Impressionist masterpieces in a former railway station.

attractions.name: Seine river cruise
attractions.description: See the landmarks from the water.

destinations.name: Swiss Alps
destinations.summary: Glaciers, alpine lakes and scenic railways, with hiking in summer and skiing in winter.

attractions.name: Jungfraujoch
attractions.description: Train to 'the Top of Europe' at 3,454 m.

attractions.name: Gornergrat and the Matterhorn
attractions.description: Cog railway to views of the Matterhorn.

attractions.name: Lake Brienz cruise
attractions.description: Turquoise lake between Interlaken and Brienz.

attractions.name: Grindelwald First
attractions.description: Cliff walk, zipline and alpine trails.

attractions.name: Lauterbrunnen Valley
attractions.description: Valley of 72 waterfalls.

destinations.name: Cappadocia
destinations.summary: Fairy-chimney valleys and cave towns, best seen from a hot-air balloon at dawn.

attractions.name: Sunrise hot-air balloon flight
attractions.description: Float over fairy chimneys at dawn.

attractions.name: Göreme Open-Air Museum
attractions.description: Rock-cut churches with Byzantine frescoes.

attractions.name: Derinkuyu Underground City
attractions.description: Multi-level city carved deep underground.

attractions.name: Rose Valley hike
attractions.description: Pink rock formations, best at sunset.

attractions.name: Uçhisar Castle
attractions.description: Highest point in Cappadocia, carved from one rock.
